verdict.rationale: Braintrust's docs say every traced request records token usage and metadata (braintrust-docs-1, braintrust-docs-53), that cost is tracked in real time (braintrust-docs-70), and that logs sit in a searchable, filterable table (braintrust-docs-37). Together these imply cost can be sliced by custom metadata, but no evidence explicitly shows cost or usage being rolled up per user, session, or feature. Missing for 10: documented cost/usage aggregation by custom metadata fields, explicit user/session/feature attribution examples, dashboards grouping cost by those dimensions, independent corroboration.
